description: This file is a shell script used for testing the output of 'git status' with various options and scenarios. It includes multiple test cases for different states of a git repository, such as initial commit, staged changes, branch tracking, conflicts, submodules, and more.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files/directories.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global git configuration for the test environment.

methods.name: lf_to_nul
methods.description: Converts line feeds in input to null characters.

methods.name: q_to_tab
methods.description: Replaces quote characters with tabs in input.

methods.name: q_to_nul
methods.description: Converts quoted space sequences to null characters.
